about: Plimsoll note definitions, read by packages/mcp and packages/attestor. The file holds only what the chain cannot say: the network holding the backing, the vault list (the preimage of the vaultSetHash registered in CoverageOracle), whether the note is a negative control, and where the on-chain facts live. Everything else is read from the chain at the time of use and is never configured here: outstanding (the note's totalSupply), par (its nominalValue), the threshold (LoadLine) and the holder (the note's issuer, the sole ROLE_ISSUER member). Keys are noteId = keccak256(market). Vault lists are lowercase and sorted, because canonicalHash hashes them in that order. Run scripts/check_notes.py after every edit.

0x376011be372685b3e6d566a7ba172f8b8968ac.comment: The negative control, backed by Fluid fUSDC alone. Its real on-chain obligation is 10,000 notes at a nominal of 100.00, so $1,000,000 against a position worth a few dollars, and it must always refuse. Its vault set is disjoint from PLIM-B's, so no collateral is pledged twice.
